# betterado_extension_install (Resource)

Manages the installation of an Azure DevOps Marketplace extension at the organization level.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_extension_install" "example" {
  publisher_id = "ms-securitydevops"
  extension_id = "microsoft-security-devops-azdevops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension_id` (String) The Azure DevOps Marketplace extension identifier, for example `vss-code-search`.
- `publisher_id` (String) The Azure DevOps Marketplace publisher identifier, for example `ms`.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the extension is disabled. Defaults to false.
- `version` (String) The version of the extension to install. If omitted, the latest version is installed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
